content.comment_body: Created a basic manual program for [product_name] [version_no], configured C1>RS>Q1, but the device does not respond when pressing the button. What could be the issue?

If cursor keys are used in a [product_name] program, you need to press the ESC key, hold it, and then press the intended cursor key. Also, make sure that a message text is set up in the program. If no message text exists, pressing ESC switches to the [product_name] menu instead.
